comment: calendar.c time_from_yyyymmddhhmmss() (recorder patch 001): every field but the year is out of range, and mktime() carries month 15 into 2105, day 59 past April, hour 26, minute 75 and second 99, giving 2105-04-29 03:16:39 EDT. That night is a full moon, so moveloop_preamble() announces it and adds luck; a debug Samurai then zaps a wished-for wand of death at himself, and the tombstone prints 2105. The datetime is out of range on purpose, so the segment sets datetimeOutOfRange.
